family.tagline: A studio on four floors, with the drawings in one place.
family.story: Rafiq is an architect and Abena an interior designer. They run their studio from a four-story house, with their daughter Nia as junior designer. One Companion Core in the kitchen holds the drawings.

companion.name: Hugo
companion.job: Opens BookStack in its own browser and files the project notes.
companion.limits: Files notes Rafiq names. Rafiq reads them.

companion.name: Selma
companion.job: Drafts client moodboard notes from what Abena texts it.
companion.limits: Drafts only. Abena sends every note.

companion.name: Pim
companion.job: Drafts site-visit summaries from the notes Nia texts it.
companion.limits: Drafts only. Nia sends her summaries.

popup.title: A parcel and a long climb
popup.body: A parcel waits at the front door on the lowest floor. Rafiq and Nia carry it through the lobby and up the stair tower to the kitchen.

popup.title: Unpacking on the shelf
popup.body: Abena unpacks the Companion Core, a power cable, a quick-start guide and a recovery USB drive. The Core covers about three quarters of a sheet of paper.

popup.title: One cable, one button
popup.body: Nia plugs in the cable and presses the button. The Core wakes and opens its own Wi-Fi network.

popup.title: Two networks, one phone
popup.body: Standing at the island, Rafiq joins the Core's own Wi-Fi network from his phone, then picks the home network.

popup.title: Hermes twice, OpenClaw once
popup.body: In Companion Hub, the family picks Hermes twice and OpenClaw once. They add Companion Memory (beta), Nextcloud and BookStack, then go back to work.

beats.capability: an agent with its own browser and coding tools, running in its own sandbox

popup.title: Hugo answers, dryly
popup.body: Rafiq sends the first message to Hugo, the agent he named. Hugo answers, and the Core is running.

say.speaker: rafiq
say.text: Hello, Rafiq. I am Hugo. Which project first?

beats.capability: a shared household hub for notes, shopping, chores and expenses

popup.title: One list for four floors
popup.body: Rafiq adds olives from the loft. Nia adds oat milk from her room. Abena sees both on the HomeHub shopping list at the island.

beats.capability: split shared costs with housemates, family or friends

popup.title: Who owes whom, plainly
popup.body: At the island, Nia and her parents settle the week's groceries in Spliit. It shows who owes whom and moves no money.

beats.capability: keeps your digital life on your own disk; imports are opt-in

popup.title: Abena decides what Selma uses
popup.body: Abena opens Companion Memory and chooses what Selma may use. Nothing is connected by default, and she can remove a source whenever she likes.

beats.capability: read the sites you follow in one feed, on your own Core

popup.title: Design news, on the couch
popup.body: On the couch in the living salon, Abena catches up on the design sites she follows in FreshRSS. The feed reader runs on the Core.

beats.capability: control and automate your smart home from one place, locally

popup.title: Stair lights on a schedule
popup.body: At dusk, the lights in the glass stair tower come up on a Home Assistant schedule. It runs on the Core and reaches them over the home Wi-Fi.

beats.capability: track your plants, watering and care history across rooms and beds, with photos

popup.title: A journal for the lily pond
popup.body: Abena logs the pond plants in HortusFox, with their care history and a photo for the journal.

beats.capability: draw flowcharts, floor plans and network maps in the browser

popup.title: Floor plans, drawn in a tab
popup.body: Rafiq draws a client's floor plan in draw.io, in his browser. The drawing tool is hosted on the Core.

beats.capability: write a wiki or a set of manuals in books, chapters and pages

popup.title: Hugo files the site notes
popup.body: After the site meeting, Rafiq tells Hugo what mattered. Hugo opens BookStack in its own browser and files the notes under the project. Rafiq reads them.

say.speaker: rafiq
say.text: Notes filed under the project. Please read them.

beats.capability: your files, calendar and contacts on your own Core

popup.title: Drawings in one place
popup.body: Nia opens the whole drawing set in Nextcloud, whichever floor she is working on. The files sit on the Core.

beats.capability: merge, split, compress and convert PDFs on your own Core

popup.title: Sheets merged into one set
popup.body: Rafiq merges the drawing sheets into one PDF with Stirling-PDF, ready for the client meeting. The merge runs on the Core.

beats.capability: talks to you through the messaging platform you pick

popup.title: Selma drafts, Abena designs
popup.body: Abena texts Selma her notes on a client's colors. Selma drafts the moodboard note, and Abena lays out the board in Penpot herself.
popup.note: Messages pass through the chat service you choose.

say.speaker: abena
say.text: Here is the draft note. Please read it first.

beats.capability: talks to you through the messaging platform you pick

popup.title: Pim drafts the visit summary
popup.body: Back from a site visit, Nia texts Pim her notes. Pim drafts the summary, and Nia sends it to the client herself.

say.speaker: nia
say.text: Summary drafted. Please check it before it goes.

beats.capability: turn a folder of photos and videos into a feed with albums and a timeline

popup.title: Site photos become a timeline
popup.body: Nia drops a folder of site-visit photos into Foldergram. It turns the folder into a feed with albums and a timeline.

beats.capability: store every password in a vault you host. Works with the Bitwarden apps

popup.title: Shared sign-ins, one vault
popup.body: Nia moves the studio's shared sign-ins into VaultWarden. It works with the Bitwarden apps, and the vault sits on the Core.

beats.capability: capture quick notes and journal entries in Markdown

popup.title: Observing notes, kept at home
popup.body: Nia sets up the telescope and jots the night's sky in Memos. The journal lives on the Core.

beats.capability: save web pages with a screenshot and PDF so they survive link rot

popup.title: A reference page, saved for good
popup.body: On the loft daybed, Rafiq saves a reference page to Linkwarden, with a screenshot and a PDF. The copy stays on the Core if the page moves.

popup.title: One Core, four floors
popup.body: The Chowdhury-Osei household runs a studio, a kitchen and a telescope from one Core on the second floor.

closing.body: Your drawings and project notes can live on a Companion Core at home, one place for every floor. Browse the Companion Hub store and pick your first apps.

notes: FTUE follows the owner's hotspot flow (STORY-BIBLE section 7); owner sign-off against the fact sheet is still open.
The Core is on the second floor, one stair tower above the front door; the casting stake says three flights, the house files show one. ftue-delivery says only "up the stair tower".

No TV in this home: the couch media beat is FreshRSS; Home Assistant runs the stair tower lights (no energy claim). The word screen is avoided throughout. No desk: studio beats use the Den and its bookshelf.
ftue-hello uses OpenClaw (Hugo); the Hermes disclosure note sits on studio-moodboard, the first Hermes beat.
Invented place and street: check Oriel Heights and Switchback Terrace against a map. Setting is a waterfront render, so no hillside is described.
